brief: Turns Graphviz graph text into a picture file by running the dot program, and can open the picture.
detail: You set the graph in the dot language, choose a format (svg by default; png, pdf and about fifty others), and Execute writes the graph to a working file in the temp folder and runs dot, leaving the picture in the output folder as diagram_ plus a number. The dot program is taken from $aStzLibConfig[:DotPath] or from d:/Graphviz/bin/dot.exe, and SetDotPath overrides it. Graphviz must be installed. View opens the picture in the program the system associates with it; it was read but not run, because it opens a window. Three defects are recorded in the methods: SetOutputFormat refuses upper case, SetOutput does not check, and CleanupAll does not delete the picture.
example: o1.SetCode("digraph G { a -> b; b -> c; }")
